sentences.text: Wentworth Earl Miller III -LRB- born June 2 , 1972 -RRB- is a British-American actor , model , and screenwriter .

He rose to prominence following his role as Michael Scofield in the five seasons of the Fox series Prison Break , for which he received a Golden Globe Award nomination for Best Actor in a Leading Role .	Michael Scofield	Michael Scofield	Fox	Fox Broadcasting Company	Prison Break	Prison Break	Golden Globe Award	Golden Globe Award
He made his screenwriting debut with the 2013 thriller film Stoker .	Stoker	Stoker (film)

In 2014 , he began playing Leonard Snart/Captain Cold in a recurring role on The CW series The Flash before becoming a series regular on the spin-off Legends of Tomorrow .	Leonard Snart/Captain Cold	Captain Cold	The CW	The CW	The Flash	The Flash (2014 TV series)	Legends of Tomorrow	Legends of Tomorrow

Miller reprised his role as Michael Scofield for the fifth season of the limited-run Prison Break revival , airing in spring 2017 .	Michael Scofield	Michael Scofield	Prison Break	Prison Break	fifth season	Prison Break (season 5)
